verdict.rationale: Registered agent service is a fair question for a virtual business mailbox provider, but the evidence pack never mentions registered agent or service-of-process handling. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a street address that 'meets business registration requirements' is not agent service, and the 'BUNDLE & SAVE 35%' offer covers mail and calls only.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get registered agent service tied to the same account — service-of-process handling bundled with or added to my mailbox plan
